desc:
🗾 いらっしゃいませ！Welcome to your Konbini adventure 🍙🛒

🏪 Own and operate your own store
🍜 Unpack crates, organize your products, and decorate your dream Konbini
💸 Set prices, earn money, and reinvest to unlock rare products
🧍‍♀️ Hire NPC cashiers or restockers to help during rush hours
📦 Sell snacks, drinks, and surprising products
🌙 Open or close your store, watch the day-night cycle, and level up your shop each day
🛻 Drive your truck to visit your friends stores

毎日が新しい挑戦。街一番のコンビ二になれるか？
